name: 15668 · Murrysville, PA
findings: ZIP 15668 (Murrysville) has 67 nonprofit organizations. 38 of them (57%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 28 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 15668 (Murrysville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 15668 (Murrysville) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 27 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.
